about_the_game:
A forgotten bond between data and emotion

V-Monsters Forgotten Link is a turn-based monster RPG with strategic 3×3 battles and mid-fight evolutions, set in a digital world on the brink of collapse.

Dive into Folklora, a system built to simulate a perfect life — until one experiment went out of control.

Follow Akira, a former soldier from the Northern Region who deserts the army after witnessing the horrors of his first battle. Together with his partner V-Monster Jareh, he joins the Southern guardian Zoe and the rebel Pulsebun to uncover the truth behind their collapsing world.

Engage in 3×3 turn-based battles where positioning and team synergy decide the outcome. Build your formations, chain attacks, and master each V-Monster’s unique skills.

During battle, your partners can evolve mid-fight, changing their stats, abilities, and even their roles on the team.

This mechanic adds a whole new layer of strategy, making every encounter unpredictable — and every evolution unforgettable.

  • Two protagonists, two sides of one war — Experience the stories of Akira, a Northern soldier seeking redemption, and Zoe, a Southern guardian fighting for freedom. Each route reveals new secrets about the conflict and about Folklora itself.

  • A semi-open pixel art world — Explore Folklora’s regions in detailed pixel art inspired by classic RPGs, blending nostalgia with modern narrative design.

  • Mid-battle evolutions — Don’t wait for the results screen. Watch your V-Monsters evolve in the middle of combat and turn the tide of battle in your favor.

  • Choices that shape destiny — Your decisions influence how the story unfolds. Allies can become enemies, and your bond with your V-Monsters may decide who makes it out alive.

Explore Folklora, an artificial world inspired by the landscapes of the Korean Peninsula — from the industrial ruins of the North to the peaceful forests of the South. Each region reveals fragments of truth, corrupted memories, and secrets left behind by the developers.

Discover war-torn villages, zones flooded with unstable code, and hidden areas lying beyond the edges of the simulation.

Some paths will even lead you into the real world, where the line between creator and creation finally disappears.
